info.title: Cranberry Forge optional local companion
info.description: Optional local Node companion; run npm run dev. These endpoints are not hosted on the static showcase. Every POST requires an application/json body of at most 2 MiB (2,097,152 bytes). Satchel, Chatter and Trailmark requests are stateless: callers supply definitions and saves and persist returned snapshots.

422.description: Invalid options, points or request limits

post.summary: Query local XZ footprints for up to 10000 points
post.description: Includes boundaries. Ignores altitude, world transforms, charge progress and physics. Results preserve input order.

422.description: Invalid options, points or request limits

post.summary: Craft atomically from an inventory save
post.description: Stateless. Supply catalog, snapshot and one recipe. HTTP limits: 96 grid cells; 1–8 ingredient entries and 1–8 output entries; 1–256 catalog definitions; 2 MiB body. Failed gameplay returns HTTP 200 with result.ok=false and no committed inventory or ID changes. Invalid data returns 422. No batch times parameter.

smelt.summary: Consume ore and fit an ingot in the freed cells

200.description: Successful request, including result.ok=false gameplay outcomes where applicable.

noSpace.summary: If a recipe instead requests two ingots, all work rolls back

post.summary: Validate and normalize a branching dialogue graph
post.description: Returns the normalized story without executing onEnter or choice effects. Limits: 256 nodes, 64 variables, 12 choices per node, 16 conditions per choice, 32 effects per list, 2 MiB body. References and variable types are validated.

200.description: Successful request, including result.ok=false gameplay outcomes where applicable.

post.summary: Start, inspect or advance a saved dialogue
post.description: Stateless. Omit snapshot to start, or restore a supplied object/JSON string without replaying entry effects. Supply at most one action: choiceId or advance:true. No action returns the current view. Valid but unavailable actions return HTTP 200 with result.ok=false; invalid snapshots (including explicit falsy values), action shapes and incompatible stories return 422. Resubmit the same story and persist the returned snapshot.

200.description: Successful request, including result.ok=false gameplay outcomes where applicable.

unavailable.summary: Attempting enter before help preserves the save

post.summary: Inspect or apply one quest-journal operation to a save
post.description: Stateless Trailmark companion: activate, dispatch, claim or omitted action for inspection. Limits: 128 quests; 64 objectives per quest; 1,024 objectives total; 32 prerequisites; 16 tags; event amount 1–1,000,000; target 1–1,000,000,000; 2 MiB body. Fresh journals retain 2,048 accepted event IDs; restored saves preserve capacities up to 10,000. Dedupe is bounded FIFO within the supplied forward save history. Claims acknowledge local receipts, not external reward transactions. Latch remains JavaScript-only because it requires a live Three.js scene and input state.

post.description: Build native Three.js geometry from options, return normalized recipe and arc-length frames, then dispose temporary resources. Local-space vectors/quaternions are numeric arrays. HTTP samples are bounded to [0,1]; closed sample(1) wraps to zero. This does not return a mesh or render an image.

post.description: Supply grid options or a saved snapshot, optional atomic cell edits, and start/goal cells. Returns route status and resulting grid snapshot. A blocked or unreachable route is a normal 200 response with empty path and null cost. No server session is retained.

post.summary: Advance a scalar damped spring analytically
post.description: All state values are required. Units are seconds and hertz; dampingRatio is dimensionless. The target remains constant during the step. Returns detached value, velocity and target. Output outside package bounds rejects.

200.description: Successful request (inspect action status in the result)

422.description: Invalid data, incompatible snapshot or exceeded workload bound

post.description: Open 1–1000 draws from a flat table. Supply a uint32 seed for a new stream or a table-compatible snapshot to resume it. An explicit seed with a save must match. Pity is a hard guarantee on the Nth consecutive eligible attempt, with natural qualifying drops resetting misses. Returns next-roll odds. Does not grant items or retain state.

200.description: Successful request (inspect action status in the result)

422.description: Invalid data, incompatible snapshot or exceeded workload bound

post.summary: Advance ability clocks and optionally spend a charge
post.description: Supply definitions/options for a new clock or a snapshot to resume. First tick dt seconds (default 0), then optionally tryUse the supplied use ID. A blocked use is a normal 200 response with result.ok=false. No server clock or wall-time advancement occurs. Missing charges refill sequentially; cooldown runs concurrently.

200.description: Successful request (inspect action status in the result)

SignalOptions.description: Circle/ring, cone and beam options. innerRadius must be less than radius. Dimensions use local world units; cones/beams point along −Z.

SatchelCatalog.description: IDs must be unique. Catalog definitions are supplied by the caller and are not stored in the snapshot.

quantity.description: Must not exceed the referenced catalog item maxStack.

nextId.description: Must exceed every existing stack ID suffix. The upper bound is the exhausted-ID sentinel.

SatchelSnapshot.description: HTTP save format. columns × rows must be at most 96. Stack IDs are unique; rotated catalog footprints must fit without overlap; total catalog weight must not exceed maxWeight. Item IDs must exist in the supplied catalog. Returned saves contain these fields only.

oneOf.description: JSON-encoded SatchelSnapshot. The decoded object is validated, including the same 96-cell limit.

SatchelRecipe.description: Crafted once per request. Entries must reference the supplied catalog. Ingredients are removed before outputs are added; all work is committed together or discarded. No times parameter is exposed by HTTP.

SatchelCraftResponse.description: HTTP 200 includes valid gameplay failures. On result.ok=false, no inputs, outputs or IDs are committed; snapshot is the normalized input save. Persist snapshot and supply it on the next request.

ChatterVariables.description: Named scalar state. Effects, comparisons and restored values must match the type declared by the story.

ChatterEffect.description: variable must be declared. add requires a numeric variable. The resulting value must remain within ChatterValue limits.

ChatterCondition.description: variable must be declared and value must match its type. Ordered comparisons require numbers. All conditions on a choice must pass.

target.description: An existing node ID, or null to end the conversation.

ChatterChoice.description: Choice IDs must be unique within their node. A once choice is disabled after successful use; unavailable choices remain in the view with enabled=false.

next.description: An existing node ID, or null to end the conversation.

ChatterNode.description: Use choices or a non-null next, not both. text and choice text interpolate declared variables with {{name}}. onEnter runs on fresh entry, including self-transitions, and never during snapshot restoration.

ChatterStory.description: Data-only dialogue graph. start and every non-null target/next must name an existing node. Every referenced variable and interpolation must be declared. No JavaScript evaluation or remote loading occurs.

signature.description: Library-generated compatibility fingerprint for the normalized story; preserve unchanged. Not an authentication signature.

usedChoices.description: Existing once choices, encoded as nodeId/choiceId.

ChatterSnapshot.description: Must match the supplied normalized story, including its ID and fingerprint. variables must contain exactly the declared keys and types. All node/choice references must exist. Restoring does not replay onEnter effects. The server does not retain this save.

oneOf.description: JSON-encoded ChatterSnapshot; the decoded object must pass the same validation.

text.description: Rendered text with scalar interpolation applied.

ChatterValidateResponse.description: Normalized graph with defaults. Validation does not start a conversation or execute effects.

choiceId.description: Select a choice on the current node. An unknown string returns not-found.

advance.description: Advance a node without choices; a null next ends the conversation.

ChatterStepRequest.description: Omit snapshot to start fresh; every explicitly supplied snapshot is validated (null, false, 0 and empty string are invalid). Supply either choiceId or advance:true, or neither to inspect the current view. Restore/start occurs before the optional action. Resubmit the same story on every request.

ChatterStepResponse.description: HTTP 200 includes valid gameplay failures. A failed choice/advance leaves the restored state unchanged. A fresh conversation has already run the start node effects before its optional action. Persist snapshot for the next call.

TrailmarkIdentifier.description: Exact, case-sensitive nonblank string. Whitespace is not trimmed; no lowercase-only identifier restriction.

TrailmarkObjectiveDefinition.description: An active objective receives an event only when type matches exactly and every required tag occurs in the event. Extra event tags are allowed. Counts clamp at target.

TrailmarkQuestDefinition.description: Objective IDs are unique within the quest. Every prerequisite names an existing quest and cycles are invalid. Completion or claim satisfies a prerequisite, but activation remains explicit.

TrailmarkDefinitions.description: Quest IDs are unique. At most 1,024 objectives total. Unknown fields reject. Definition/objective order is part of save compatibility; keep definitions unchanged for continuation.

TrailmarkEvent.description: Malformed events reject before duplicate checking. Valid duplicates are identified only by id, irrespective of changed payload. One event can update every matching active objective in catalog order. Inactive quests receive no retroactive progress.

id.description: Stable local receipt ID: questId + @ + completedAt.

TrailmarkReceipt.description: claimedAt is null until acknowledged by claim. This is local journal state, not an authenticated receipt or an external reward transaction.

TrailmarkQuestView.description: Detached view in definition order. Inactive quests display available or locked according to completed prerequisites; neither status implies activation.

TrailmarkSnapshotQuest.description: IDs and counters match definition order. idle requires zero counts and null activation/receipt; active requires a valid activation, incomplete objectives and no receipt; completed/claimed require all counters at target and a valid receipt. Claimed receipts require claimedAt after completedAt.

catalogKey.description: Exact JSON of normalized definitions generated by the package. Preserve unchanged; this is a compatibility key, not a signature.

dedupeCapacity.description: Fresh HTTP journals use 2,048. Restored saves retain recorded capacities, including custom JavaScript journal capacities.

recentEvents.description: At most dedupeCapacity accepted events, strictly ordered by sequence with unique IDs. Unmatched accepted events also occupy capacity.

TrailmarkSnapshot.description: Versioned object save; encoded JSON strings are not accepted. All fields are required; unknown fields reject. IDs, order, counters, prerequisites, receipt identities and operation ordering are validated against definitions. Sequences must fit the journal history. Restore neither dispatches events nor repeats completion/claim results.

TrailmarkAction.description: Exactly one action. Omit action entirely to inspect; null and unknown types/fields reject. Unknown quest IDs return HTTP 422.

TrailmarkActivationResult.description: Failed activation does not advance sequence or alter the save.

TrailmarkDispatchResult.description: Accepted events advance sequence even without changes. Duplicates change nothing and do not refresh FIFO retention. Each completion appears once along a forward saved history; stale saves can replay history.

TrailmarkStepResult.description: Exact method result. Inspection returns null. Claim returns a newly acknowledged receipt, or null for a known quest that is incomplete or already claimed; null claims leave the save unchanged.

TrailmarkStepRequest.description: Omit snapshot to create a fresh journal, otherwise provide a valid object save. Explicit falsy saves/actions reject. Omit action to inspect. Custom dedupe configuration is accepted as part of a compatible save; no top-level dedupeCapacity option exists.

TrailmarkStepResponse.description: HTTP 200 includes blocked activation, duplicate dispatch and null claim results; there is no generic ok field. The server retains no journal/history. Save snapshot and submit it with the same definitions next time.

width.description: Profile keys strictly increase from at=0 to at=1. Closed routes require equal endpoint values.

bank.description: Profile keys strictly increase from at=0 to at=1. Closed routes require equal endpoint values.

UnprocessableEntity.description: Invalid request, story, save, catalog, recipe or limits; includes effects that exceed scalar/visit limits.
